test_title: SSC Selection Post 2024 (Higher Secondary Level) Official Paper (Held On: 21 Jun, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Identify the error in the verb form in the following sentence and choose the correct sentence from the given options (Present Tense).

Earth revolve around the sun.

options.text: Earth has revolve around the sun.
Earth are revolve around the sun.

solution:
The correct answer is **'****Earth revolves around the sun.****'**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The error in the sentence is the incorrect form of the verb "**revolve**."
 
• In the present tense, the verb must agree with the singular subject "**Earth**."
 
• The correct verb form is "**revolves**" to indicate **singular third-person present tense**.
 
• Therefore, the correct sentence is "**Earth revolves around the sun.**"

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Earth revolves around the sun."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2:** "Earth has revolve around the sun" is incorrect because "has" should be followed by "revolved" (past participle) to form the present perfect tense.
 
• **Option 3:** "Earth revolved around the sun" is incorrect because it is in the past tense, while the requirement is for the present tense.
 
• **Option 4:** "Earth are revolve around the sun" is incorrect because "are" should agree with a plural subject and it should be followed by "revolving" if it were correct, but it still doesn't fit the simple present requirement.
